name: Prophecies Respecting Christ
overview: Scripture reveals Christ as the promised seed through whom God’s covenant and blessing extend to all nations, beginning with the patriarchs Abraham and Isaac. From the enmity foretold between the woman's seed and the serpent in Genesis 3:15, to the establishment of an everlasting covenant with Abraham’s descendants (Genesis 17:7) and the blessing of all nations through Abraham's seed (Genesis 22:18), the Bible anticipates the coming Messiah. The scepter of Judah and the gathering of people to Shiloh (Genesis 49:10) further affirm Christ’s royal lineage, while the detailed instructions in Exodus 12:46 subtly foreshadow His sacrificial role. These prophecies collectively underscore Christ’s divine appointment and fulfillment of God’s redemptive plan.
